name: com.promptmentions/promptmentions
title: PromptMentions
description: Read-only AI visibility data: brand mentions, cited sources and answers across AI engines.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: The workspace this key belongs to, the key’s permissions and the client projects it can read.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Client projects with their brand, aliases, tracked competitors and locale. Requires the projects:read key permission.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: One client project. Requires the projects:read key permission.

tools.name: list_prompt_sets
tools.description: Prompt sets for a client, with every saved revision, its locale and prompts. Requires the projects:read key permission.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: Monitoring runs for a client, newest first, with sample counts. Paginate with cursor. Requires the monitoring:read key permission.

tools.name: get_run_metrics
tools.description: One run with labelled metrics (mention rate, citation rates, tracked mention share) and competitor share of voice with 95% Wilson ranges. Requires the monitoring:read key permission.

tools.name: list_samples
tools.description: Every sample of one run: provider, interface, models, prompt, locale, time, status, extracted mentions and citations, and the evidence file hash. Requires the monitoring:read key permission.

tools.name: get_citations
tools.description: Domains and pages cited in one run’s successful answers, classified (client, competitor, directory, editorial, social, other), and citation gaps. Requires the monitoring:read key permission.

tools.name: get_sample_evidence
tools.description: The preserved evidence file of one sample: the provider’s raw response, parsed answer text and citations, and the extraction summary. Over MCP the raw provider body is omitted unless includeRaw is "true". Requires the evidence:read key permission.

includeRaw.description: MCP only: "true" to include the raw provider response

tools.name: list_opportunities
tools.description: Tasks and opportunities for a client with their source evidence, priority basis, assumptions and state. Paginate with cursor. Requires the opportunities:read key permission.

tools.name: get_looker_rows
tools.description: Flat rows for Looker Studio and spreadsheets. dataset "visibility" (default): per day, engine, model, prompt and tracked brand, the successful answers and how many named the brand; failed answers are not counted. "social-pages": per cited social or community page and week, as on Sources › Social pages. "lost-citations": pages cited less or not lately in the 90 days up to "to", as on Sources › Lost citations. Default: the last 30 days; at most 93. Requires the reports:read key permission.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: A client report for a UTC date window (default: last 30 days, at most 93): monitoring runs with labelled metrics, opportunity changes and caveats. Requires the reports:read key permission.
